Subject: Re: Orchard: Narrowing SOC 2 & SIG scoping — call? — notes + actions

Hi Melissa, Carlos, Tara — thanks for the call today. Notes and owners below (pulled from the meeting recording). Let me know if I've missed anything.

Meeting summary:
- Confirmed SIG scope: cloud infrastructure, change management, access controls, logging/monitoring, incident response, and retention for PII/PHI. Orchard does not need Redwood's internal HR controls at this time.
- Redwood SOC 2: Redwood has an internal SOC 2 audit in progress; projected Type II report delivery Q4 2026. We shared bridge documentation (control maps) during the call.

Action items (owner — due):
- Aditya Rao — provide authoritative network diagram + cloud provider list + network segmentation notes (network-diagram.pdf). Due: 2026-08-18.
- Lauren Bishop — export of data retention policy + S3 lifecycle config screenshots for customer buckets. Due: 2026-08-20.
- Soojin Lee — provide completed CAIQ export (v0.4) with added references to evidence artifacts and a control map linking to SOC 2 workpapers. Due: 2026-08-19.
- Melissa/Tara — share Orchard intake spreadsheet and any required formatting expectations (HubSpot link shared).

Questions raised (and short answers):
- Q: Do you persist logs for >90 days by default? A: Application logs: 30 days, aggregated telemetry 90 days; security logs retained for 365 days for intrusion detection. We'll attach policy snippets.
- Q: Is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit? A: Yes — KMS-managed encryption for storage; TLS 1.2+ in transit. We'll add KMS key ownership notes.
- Q: Any on-prem components? A: No — Redwood Private is available as a customer-deployed option, but Orchard would be on our hosted or dedicated offering.

Attachments referenced: network-diagram.pdf (Aditya), meeting-audio.mp3 (recording), Redwood_CAiq_answers_v0.3.xlsx (updated baseline).

Next steps: I'll send the calendar invite with the recording and put action items into our shared HubSpot ticket. Expect the CAIQ v0.4 by 8/19.

Thanks all —

--
Soojin Lee
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
